intro: September opens with a flourish — the Big Bike Film Night rides into HOTA Cinema on Tuesday, Mamma Mia! makes its Gold Coast debut at The Star on Friday, and the Crafted Beer Festival throws a 10th-birthday party across Kurrawa Park the following weekend. SWELL transforms Currumbin Beach from the 11th, while Kids Take Over lands at HOTA from the 14th for two weeks of school-holiday spectacle. Later in the season: Groundwater Country Music brings Kasey Chambers and friends to free stages across Broadbeach on 16–18 October, and BLEACH* lights up the Coast from the 1st.
topPicksTitle: Top Things To Do This Week (31 Aug – 7 Sep)

topPicks.name: The Big Bike Film Night
topPicks.desc: Ten international cycling short films — action, drama and humour — on the big screen at HOTA. A pedal-powered evening right on the doorstep.

topPicks.date: From Wednesday 2 September · La Boite, Brisbane
topPicks.name: Koreaboo
topPicks.desc: A sharp new comedy about identity, fandom and belonging at La Boite — fresh Australian theatre with serious buzz. Worth the trip north.

topPicks.date: From Friday 4 September · The Star, Gold Coast
topPicks.name: Mamma Mia!
topPicks.desc: ABBA's greatest hits wrapped in sunshine and Greek-island joy — Mamma Mia! opens at The Star Broadbeach for a limited Gold Coast season.

topPicks.name: Brisbane Festival 2026
topPicks.desc: Three weeks of theatre, music and riverside spectacle kick off across South Bank. An easy day-trip from the villa when a headline act catches your eye.

events.name: The Big Bike Film Night
events.desc: Ten international cycling short films curated by New Zealand's Brett Cotter — 2.5 hours of action, drama and inspiration on the big screen at HOTA Cinema. A pedal-powered evening 10 minutes from the villa.
events.location: HOTA Cinema, Surfers Paradise · 10 min drive

events.name: This Moment — Dining at Palette
events.desc: HOTA's This Moment exhibition spills into Palette restaurant — art-inspired dining where the menu answers the gallery. A refined long lunch, ten minutes from the villa.

events.name: Mamma Mia! The Musical
events.desc: 25 years of ABBA magic in a lavish Gold Coast debut — feel-good story, dazzling cast, Dancing Queen. Right here in Broadbeach at The Star.
events.location: The Star Gold Coast, Broadbeach · 15 min drive

events.name: Crafted Beer Festival
events.desc: 10th birthday bash at Kurrawa Park — 50+ craft breweries, 400+ brews, indie live music (The Vanns and more), gourmet food trucks and a beachside BBQ smokeshow. Five minutes down the road.

events.name: SWELL Sculpture Festival
events.desc: The Gold Coast's most-loved outdoor gallery — large-scale sculptures along Currumbin's sand at sunrise, sunset and everything between. Free, iconic, unmissable.

events.name: Kids Take Over Festival
events.desc: Spring school holidays launch a space-themed extravaganza at HOTA — Erth's life-like Dinosaurs, the Hot Potato Band, a Galactic Space Wall by 1,000 local students, workshops and free daily activities.

events.name: Brisbane Festival 2026
events.desc: The city's biggest celebration of art and community — three weeks of theatre, music, dance and riverside spectacle across South Bank and beyond. Worth planning a day trip around.
events.location: South Bank & citywide, Brisbane · 75 min drive

events.name: Koreaboo
events.desc: A sharp new comedy at La Boite about identity, fandom and belonging — fresh Australian theatre with serious buzz.

events.name: Anastasia The Musical
events.desc: The sweeping Broadway musical journeys from the twilight of the Russian Empire to 1920s Paris — lavish, romantic and made for a special night out.

events.name: Groundwater Country Music Festival
events.desc: Free three-day country music celebration across Broadbeach — Kasey Chambers, Kaylee Bell, The Wolfe Brothers and 30+ acts on outdoor stages. No tickets, no fuss, just great music in the sun.

events.name: BLEACH Festival 2026
events.desc: The Gold Coast's signature arts festival returns — eleven days of live music, theatre and large-scale spectacle at HOTA and across the city, headlined by Six60. The Coast at its most alive.
